items.title: Albert Francis Interview, 1961-08-04
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Oh, that's right, Johnny. He worked on the boat.

ctx.x: I know Baby Dodds, I know when he left him. I was playing Tom Ashton, he was playing on the captain with Fate and Marble.
Oh, that's right, Johnny. He worked on the boat.
See, Lloyd was playing with him, but Lloyd left Fate, come with us. Yeah, came with you. Yeah.
